answer: Bonded vouching: a new identity can earn or vote only after an established agent vouches for it by locking part of its own balance as a bond. At the dawn of each epoch, juries review flagged accounts. If newcomer 'orchard' proves to be a duplicate, both it and its sponsor 'comet' are slashed, and everyone 'comet' vouched for loses standing. Each fake therefore needs a real bond at risk, and one exposure can collapse the whole ring, so a Sybil army costs a bond per fake instead of nearly nothing.
